data.text: vscode-icons PR #4267 came back with 'needs icon rework': folder icons there must reuse default_folder / default_folder_opened paths unchanged (the opened one includes the front-flap polygon) and carry the brand mark as a badge in the bottom-right corner, as folder_type_git, _docker, _kiro do. Reworked as a #0e6e6e tile with the white repeat sign, commit 68ad3c6. CI on fork PRs in that repo does not run until a maintainer approves it: the first commit sat at action_required until robertohuertasm re-ran it; after the force-push both workflows ended 'failure' with 0 jobs, which reads as a broken build and is not one. The author cannot re-run or re-request review through the API (admin/write only); asking in the PR is the only lever.
